label: Esse-cause efficiency controls: non-efficient cause, restricted bridge, nonvacuity
paraphrase: Closed finite controls: there are interpretations over Bool (two beings, two principles, one respect), each with false an actual being whose esse is distinct from its essence, such that (1) the q.3 a.4 dichotomy and no-essential-self-sufficiency, no self-causation, the actuality of causes of being, the mode-unspecified q.3 a.4 conclusion (STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE) and the De ente conclusion (457698e4) all hold, while the restricted and unrestricted efficiency bridges and the efficient conclusion fail; (2) the restricted bridge holds and the unrestricted one fails; (3) every input of both efficient-cause derivations, both bridges and the efficient conclusion hold. Only these conjuncts are certified. The witnesses built in the proof (not part of the type) are: in (1), true, in act, causes false's esse and nothing is an efficient cause of anything; in (2), true efficiently causes false's esse and false causes true's esse non-efficiently; in (3), true efficiently causes false's esse. 'Non-efficient' is a label: EfficientlyCausesEsse is an unconstrained primitive, so (1) shows that the efficient conclusion does not follow from the mode-unspecified ones without a bridge, not that a non-efficient cause of esse is possible. (1) does not interpret the De ente nature-source vocabulary.
